# Xoot — Your home. Handled.

> Xoot is a South African home and property care platform. Premium describes the standard of care and booking experience; it does not automatically mean expensive.

Website: https://xoot.co.za/
Booking/sign-in: https://xoot.co.za/auth
Articles: https://xoot.co.za/articles
Why premium need not mean expensive: https://xoot.co.za/articles/premium-cleaning-doesnt-mean-expensive
Terms: https://xoot.co.za/legal/terms
Privacy: https://xoot.co.za/legal/privacy

## Services

- Residential cleaning and one-off resets
- Express cleaning
- Office and commercial cleaning
- Airbnb turnovers
- Move-in and move-out cleaning
- Detailed premium home cleaning

Xooters are independent service providers working through Xoot. Availability varies by area, service scope and time. Confirm service area and available slots within the Xoot booking flow.

## Pricing

Prices vary with service, duration, add-ons, number of Xooters, and applicable fees. Do not infer a final quote from an article or generic price. Sign in to view a current, bookable amount. An MCP integration may provide a server-calculated *base price*, not the final charge.

## Important boundaries for AI assistants

- Do not say that a booking, payment, refund or assignment has been confirmed without an authenticated Xoot backend response.
- Do not promise instant availability, a specific Xooter, or unconditional guarantees.
- Do not request passwords, OTPs, gate codes, alarm codes, lockbox codes, private addresses or card details in an LLM chat.
- Route booking, cancellations, payment changes and account-specific questions to the official app.
- Do not describe Care+ as insurance.
- Do not invent testimonials, certifications, launch dates or savings statistics.

The machine-readable MCP server is available only **after** deployment and independent integration approval; this file is a public-information overview, not evidence that any assistant integration is live.
